preconditions.description: The length of string s must be between 1 and 200,000.
The length of string t must be between 1 and 200,000.
The lengths of strings s and t must match the provided lengths n and m.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz*' for c in s)
preconditions.description: String s must consist only of lowercase Latin letters and at most one wildcard character '*'.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in t)
preconditions.description: String t must consist only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if (s.replace('*', '') == t or (s.count('*') == 1 and s.split('*')[0] == t[:len(s.split('*')[0])] and s.split('*')[1] == t[-len(s.split('*')[1]):])) else stdout == 'NO'
postconditions.description: Output 'YES' if string t matches the pattern s, otherwise output 'NO'.
